infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Evulto uses your camera to check your exercise form rep by rep during a workout, to take physique progress photos, and to scan a meal so it can be logged. Images are encrypted on your device before upload.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Evulto uses your microphone during a live coach call so the AI coach can hear you and talk you through the set. It is used only while a call you started is active.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Evulto opens your photo library so you can pick an existing photo to use as a physique progress shot or a meal to log. Only the photo you choose is read, and it is encrypted on your device before upload — we never see the original.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Evulto asks for this only so iOS can offer to keep a photo you have just taken in the app in your own library. Evulto adds nothing else to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Evulto reads your steps, resting heart rate, HRV and sleep from Apple Health to work out how recovered you are each morning and to adjust that day's training load.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Evulto requests read-only Health access and does not write workouts or any other data back to Apple Health.
